skills.name: Advantages and disadvantages of a traditional kitchen

worked_example.problem: Give one advantage and one disadvantage of the smoke in a traditional kitchen.
steps: Smoke dries and preserves meat, fish and maize on the smoke rack, and keeps some insects away: an advantage.
Smoke also hurts the eyes and the lungs of the cook: a disadvantage.
worked_example.answer: Advantage: it preserves food. Disadvantage: it harms the eyes and lungs.

cards.idea: A traditional kitchen is cheap to build and to run, and its smoke rack preserves food.
example: Mud, wood and thatch can be found locally.

cards.idea: But smoke harms the eyes and lungs, soot blackens everything, and there is a risk of fire and burns.
example: A thatch roof can catch fire from sparks.

cards.idea: An improved stove and a window or chimney reduce the smoke in a traditional kitchen.
example: A chimney carries smoke out of the kitchen.

check.prompt: Which change makes a traditional kitchen less smoky?

right.text: making a window to let smoke out

wrong.explain: Closed openings keep the smoke in.

questions.prompt: Traditional kitchen: sort these into advantages and disadvantages.

pool.left: cheap to build with local materials
a place for the family to sit together

questions.prompt: Which is an advantage of a traditional kitchen?

right.text: It is cheap to build with local materials.

wrong.text: It is easy to keep clean.
wrong.explain: Soot and earth floors make it hard to clean.
Open fires and thatch roofs are a fire risk.

questions.prompt: Which is a disadvantage of a traditional kitchen?

right.text: Smoke hurts the eyes and lungs.
Soot blackens the walls and pots.
It uses a lot of firewood.

wrong.text: It is warm in the cold season.
It can be built with local materials.

questions.prompt: One sentence is wrong. Which one?

right.text: Smoke from a wood fire can harm the lungs.
A thatch roof can catch fire.
A traditional kitchen is cheap to build.
Burning a lot of firewood leads to cutting down trees.

wrong.text: Soot is easy to wash off walls.
A traditional kitchen never has smoke.
Children are safe near an open fire.
wrong.explain: Children can be burnt by an open fire.
